elements.text:
Lots of your classmates have a Tiktok account. You set up your own Tiktok account and post a funny opening tweet. After a few days you only have one follower. Why do you have only one follower? 

There are so many Tiktok accounts to follow that mine just hasn't been noticed. 

On a scale of 1-5, how likely is this thought to pop into your mind?

buttons: 1::1: Doesn't pop up in my mind
3::3: Might pop up in my mind
5::5: Definitely pops up in my mind
